headline: Oregon Lawmakers Fund Purchase of Iconic Waterfall
meta_description: An iconic Oregon waterfall that was listed for sale on Redfin will be preserved after lawmakers approved funding to purchase it.
summary_short: An iconic Oregon waterfall threatened by private sale will now be protected after lawmakers approved the money needed to buy it.
body:
An iconic Oregon waterfall that appeared on the real estate market will be preserved for the public. The property was listed for sale on Redfin, but lawmakers acted quickly to approve funding for its purchase, ensuring the landmark remains accessible to the community.

The decision reflects growing recognition of the importance of protecting natural landmarks from private ownership. By securing the necessary funds, legislators have prevented what could have been restricted public access to a cherished regional treasure.

This outcome demonstrates how swift legislative action can safeguard irreplaceable natural features. The waterfall now joins Oregon's collection of protected public lands, available for future generations to experience and enjoy.
quick_facts: Iconic Oregon waterfall was listed on Redfin for sale
Lawmakers approved funding to purchase the property
Purchase protects public access to the natural landmark
